# Seal Bot source provenance

Seal Bot adapts Fei2411/DS-Bot, commit `84c3cb86b997aec53281b842fd162f3f6b4ee7be` (2026-11-10), from <https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot>.

The upstream project is licensed under Apache License 2.0. Its unmodified LICENSE and NOTICE are retained beside this file. Product changes include renaming the plugin and browser storage namespace, moving its data root, disabling upstream update paths, and composing it into Seal Harness. See the local Git history for exact changes.
